kenya.title: Flag of Kenya

colors.note: Commemorates the blood shed for independence

desc: - Horizontal black, red, and green bands with white fimbriations, centred with a Maasai shield and crossed spears. Adopted upon independence in 1963
trivia:
- The shield and spears represent defence of freedom; the black represents the people
- The green and white bands represent the land and peace; red represents bloodshed for independence
- Kenya's flag emphasizes both Pan-African colours and local symbols of Maasai warrior culture
